caption: The drawing depicts a single, round, decorated object resembling a carved wooden medallion or plaque, centered on a plain, off-white background. The medallion is rendered in shades of light brown and tan, showing detailing in darker brown to accentuate the patterns. The central motif is a raised, circular rosette with radiating lines or petals surrounded by a ring, resembling a stylized sun. Around this central element, four symmetrical plant-like designs with pointed leaves are evenly spaced, each pointing towards the outer rim. Between these plant motifs, there are four raised diamond-shaped decorations oriented with one point facing inward. The outer edge of the medallion features a continuous, narrow border with diagonal hatching. Below and to the right of the medallion, the name "Albert Levone" is written in small, light brown letters. The rest of the background is blank, highlighting the object.
title: Pa. German Butter Mold
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
